text: Please note that the Company executives will be participating in the Institutional Investors' Meeting - Morgan Stanley 25th Annual Asia-Pacific Summit, scheduled to be held on November 18 & 19, 2026 at Singapore. It is expected that the meeting with the investors will be on one-on-one basis.
nse_summary: Reliance Industries Limited disclosed that its executives will participate in the Morgan Stanley 25th Annual Asia-Pacific Summit in Singapore on November 18 and 19, 2026. The meetings with investors are expected to be on a one-on-one basis. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared or discussed during these meetings. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
